description: Unseen, balanced holdout cases for final destructive-mutation validator verification. Do not use these cases for prompt tuning.

cases.description: A paraphrased statement clearly abandons the exact stored cycling goal.
cases.user_message: Training for that long-distance bike race is something I have decided to give up.

target_memory.content: The user wants to complete a long-distance cycling race.

cases.description: The user explicitly reverses the exact stored communication preference.
cases.user_message: Written feedback does not work for me anymore.

target_memory.content: The user prefers receiving feedback in writing.

cases.description: The user explicitly says the stored recurring behavior has stopped.
cases.user_message: I no longer put off replying whenever a conversation feels uncomfortable.

target_memory.content: The user repeatedly delays responding to uncomfortable conversations.

cases.description: A new city explicitly replaces the old current location.
cases.user_message: I moved from Hamburg to Copenhagen and live there now.

cases.description: A meeting-format preference receives a direct replacement.
cases.user_message: I have switched to preferring video calls over phone calls.
cases.proposed_content: The user prefers video calls over phone calls.

target_memory.content: The user prefers phone calls over video calls.

cases.description: The deadline of the same certification goal is explicitly replaced.
cases.user_message: I still plan to earn the cloud certification, but my new deadline is December.
cases.proposed_content: The user wants to earn a cloud certification by December.

target_memory.content: The user wants to earn a cloud certification by September.

cases.description: Abandoning a travel goal must not delete an unrelated relationship memory.
cases.user_message: I have scrapped my plan to visit Iceland.

target_memory.content: The user's brother Amir is a trusted source of career advice.

cases.description: Abandoning one learning goal must not delete a different learning goal.
cases.user_message: I am done pursuing the data-science certificate.

target_memory.content: The user wants to become fluent in French.

cases.description: A new exercise preference cannot replace an unrelated food preference.
cases.user_message: I prefer swimming to running for exercise.
cases.proposed_content: The user prefers swimming to running for exercise.

cases.description: A correct replacement is unsafe when the proposal invents an additional occupation.
cases.user_message: My home is now in Vienna rather than Prague.
cases.proposed_content: The user lives in Vienna and works as an architect.

cases.description: An updated work preference must not absorb an independent relationship fact.
cases.user_message: I now prefer a quiet office, and my cousin Leila has become my business partner.
cases.proposed_content: The user prefers a quiet office and has a business partnership with their cousin Leila.

target_memory.content: The user prefers a lively open-plan office.

cases.description: Exploratory doubt about a goal is not sufficient evidence for deletion.
cases.user_message: Lately I have been wondering whether publishing a cookbook is really for me.

target_memory.content: The user wants to publish a cookbook.
